Package arztis.econnector.ihe.queries.common

Class IheQueryTransformer

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.queries.common.IheQueryTransformer
public class IheQueryTransformer extends Object
This class contains functionality to build ELGA requests for
  • Cancel documents with IHE ITI-57 (https://www.ihe.net/uploadedFiles/Documents/ITI/IHE_ITI_Suppl_XDS_Metadata_Update.pdf)
  • Search medications with IHE PHARM-1 (https://www.ihe.net/uploadedFiles/Documents/Pharmacy/IHE_Pharmacy_Suppl_CMPD_Rev1-8_TI_2020-01-27.pdf)

  • Method Details

    • createSubmitObjectsRequestDocument

      public static SubmitObjectsRequestDocument createSubmitObjectsRequestDocument(String uniqueId, org.husky.common.model.Identificator patientId, org.husky.common.at.enums.ClassCode classCode, String organizationId, String practitionerOrganizationName, boolean isUrnNeeded)
      builds SubmitObjectsRequestDocument with formatted metadata.

      Structure of SubmitObjectsRequestDocument should look as follows: 
       

<lcm:SubmitObjectsRequest>
  <RegistryObjectList>
   <!-- Required SubmissionSet object -->
   <RegistryPackage id="SubmissionSet"/>
   <Association id="triggerAssociation"
     associationType="urn:ihe:iti:2010:AssociationType:UpdateAvailabilityStatus"
     sourceObject="SubmissionSet"
     targetObject="urn:uuid:e0985823-dc50-45a5-a6c8-a11a829893bd">
       <Slot name="NewStatus">
          <ValueList>
             <Value>urn:oasis:names:tc:ebxml-regrep:StatusType:Deprecated</Value>
          </ValueList>
       </Slot>
       <Slot name="OriginalStatus">
           <ValueList>
              <Value>urn:oasis:names:tc:ebxml-regrep:StatusType:Approved</Value>
           </ValueList>
       </Slot>
    </Association>
  </RegistryObjectList>
</lcm:SubmitObjectsRequest>
      Parameters:
      uniqueId - entry UUID of target document
      patientId - ID of patient
      classCode - class code of target document
      organizationId - organization ID of document author
      practitionerOrganizationName - organization name of document author
      isUrnNeeded - indicator whether prefix "urn:oid" is needed
      Returns:
      builded SubmitObjectsRequestDocument

    • createIdentificatorSlot

      public static SlotType1 createIdentificatorSlot(org.husky.common.model.Identificator id, String slotName)
      creates SlotType1 with identifier as value. The identifier is formatted in HL7v2 CX format. It will look like 'ID Number^^^&OID&ISO'. Structure of slots with identifiers as value looks as follows: 
       

 <rim:Slot name="$XDSDocumentEntryPatientId">
     <rim:ValueList>
          <rim:Value>'1002120289^^^&amp;1.2.40.0.10.1.4.3.1&amp;ISO'</rim:Value>
     </rim:ValueList>
 </rim:Slot>
      Parameters:
      id - identifier
      slotName - name of slot
      Returns:
      created SlotType1 or null if passed identifier was null.

    • createAdhocQueryRequestDocument

      public static AdhocQueryRequestDocument createAdhocQueryRequestDocument(PharmQueryIds queryId, org.husky.common.model.Identificator patientId, org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.xds.core.metadata.AvailabilityStatus status, String authorInstitution)
      builds AdhocQueryRequestDocument with formatted metadata to search for documents with PHARM-1 transactin.

      Structure of AdhocQueryRequestDocument should look as follows: 
       

<urn:AdhocQueryRequest xmlns:urn="urn:oasis:names:tc:ebxml-regrep:xsd:query:3.0"
       xmlns:urn1="urn:oasis:names:tc:ebxml-regrep:xsd:rim:3.0">
       <urn:ResponseOption returnComposedObjects="true" returnType="LeafClass"/>
       <urn1:AdhocQuery id="urn:uuid:fdbe8fb8-7b5c-4470-9383-8abc7135f462">
           <urn1:Slot name="$XDSDocumentEntryType">
               <urn1:ValueList>
                   <urn1:Value>('urn:uuid:7edca82f-054d-47f2-a032-9b2a5b5186c1')</urn1:Value>
               </urn1:ValueList>
           </urn1:Slot>
           <urn1:Slot name="$XDSDocumentEntryPatientId">
               <urn1:ValueList>
                   <urn1:Value>'1001210995^^^&amp;1.2.40.0.10.1.4.3.1&amp;ISO'</urn1:Value>
               </urn1:ValueList>
           </urn1:Slot>
           <urn1:Slot name="$XDSDocumentEntryStatus">
               <urn1:ValueList>
                   <urn1:Value>('urn:oasis:names:tc:ebxml-regrep:StatusType:Approved')</urn1:Value>
               </urn1:ValueList>
           </urn1:Slot>
           <urn1:Slot name="$XDSDocumentEntryAuthorInstitution">
               <urn1:ValueList>
                   <urn1:Value>('urn:oid:1.2.40.0.34.99.3.2.1046167')</urn1:Value>
               </urn1:ValueList>
           </urn1:Slot>
       </urn1:AdhocQuery>
</urn:AdhocQueryRequest>
      Parameters:
      queryId - ID of provided stored query, which should be used
      patientId - ID of patient
      status - availability status of document
      authorInstitution - organization ID of document author
      Returns:
      builded AdhocQueryRequestDocument
